traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for story 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are satisfied with concrete implementation, tests, and documentation:
- **Before / After / Mixed Positions**: Covered by three passing tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts that place @story/@req before, after, and interleaved with @param/@returns. These are explicitly named with REQ-JSDOC-TAG-COEXISTENCE. - **Proper Termination & JSDoc Tag Detection**: Implemented via isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine() and the early boundary check in processCommentLine(); verified by the test reproducing the original bug scenario (REQ-OPTIMIZATION with subsequent @param) which now passes without concatenating JSDoc tags into the requirement ID. - **Continuation Lines & Preserve Multiline**: Pending annotations are only continued when the next normalized line does not start with another JSDoc tag; multi-line story examples (including a split story path followed by @param) are validated as correct (REQ-PRESERVE-MULTILINE, REQ-CONTINUATION-LOGIC). - **No False Positives & Clear Errors**: All coexistence examples are in the `valid` array and pass; invalid cases in the suite still trigger specific, actionable messages for genuine format issues, confirming REQ-NO-FALSE-POSITIVES and error-message clarity. - **Backward Compatibility**: The entire Jest suite (40 suites, 304 tests) passes, including many other rules and stories depending on the same parser logic, indicating no regressions in existing annotation parsing. - **Documentation**: docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md includes a dedicated "JSDoc coexistence" section that describes the exact semantics required by this story, with an example referencing this story’s path.
Given the current code, tests, and documentation, story 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE is fully implemented and verifiably passing all its defined requirements.
